verdict.rationale: Jira's docs say users can break big projects into clear tasks, and community evidence confirms that any issue can link to any other issue across projects. However, nothing explicitly documents subtasks or blocking/dependency link types that make order clear, and one user's general comment that Jira doesn't track dependencies well lowers confidence without being a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit subtask documentation, documented blocks/is-blocked-by dependency links, any view that shows blocking order, and hands-on corroboration of dependency tracking.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear
